goal: Proxy Control Plane Batch B1: introduce account-level transport epoch and dual mutation guard without yet rerouting all transition writers.
context: Critical migration, fail-closed. Add migration 000108 account_transport_state keyed by account_id with provider, transport_epoch >=1, active_proxy_id nullable, transition_reason, timestamps. Add a proxycontrol/account transport store with CurrentEpoch and atomic BumpEpoch under account-scoped transaction semantics. Runtime creation captures the current epoch for proxy-required accounts; if missing initialize safely. AccountRuntime mutation guard must require BOTH current proxy-specific generation and current account transport epoch. Direct accounts remain unaffected. Do not yet change admin proxy/profile writes or pool rotation; that is B2. Add unit and optional DOB_E2E_DSN PostgreSQL tests for monotonic epoch, missing-state fail-closed behavior, and stale runtime rejection. Preserve existing generation guard and all provider contracts.
commit_message: feat(proxy): add account transport epoch dual guard
